tagline: A little space for your next frame.
emptyText: Open a local video and settle in. Each film gets its own OTools tab — your place is remembered.
dropHint: Drop videos here, or choose files to get started
browserHint: Browser preview uses demo data. Open this plugin in OTools to play real local files.
hostHint: Files are read locally. No uploads, no sign-in.
noFilesText: A quiet place for the things you want to watch.
parallelText: When off, switching to another OTools tab pauses this player.
resumeText: Completed videos (97% or more) start from the beginning.
quotaTitle: All 8 playback slots are in use
quotaText: Close another player tab, then try again. Your other videos will not be stopped.

invalidDrop: Use the native OTools file picker or drag-drop. Browser filenames are not real local paths.
unsupportedSubtitle: Only SRT and VTT are supported in this first version. ASS styling is not preserved.
errorHint: You can retry this file or choose another. No other playback tab is affected.
